'''Singing lamps''' were a type of lamp or ornament that presumably emitted some kind of sound. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was given one as a wedding gift by a group of [[Jumerian]]s but greatly disliked it.
